title: Al boom mints new winners you've never heard of
excerpt: Every gold rush produces two kinds of fortunes. There are the people who find the gold, and there are the people who sell them the shovels. History remembers...
content_html:
Tobi Opeyemi Amure

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 8:07 PM MST 6 min read

Every gold rush produces two kinds of fortunes. There are the people who find the gold, and there are the people who sell them the shovels. History remembers the first group and quietly enriches the second.

The artificial intelligence (AI) buildout has followed that script almost to the letter. Investors who missed Nvidia (NVDA) crowded into what Wall Street calls the picks and shovels trade, buying the companies that deliver power and cooling to data centers rather than the chips humming inside them.

That trade worked. Then it got crowded, and crowded trades punish disappointment. Vertiv Holdings (VRT), the largest pure play in data center thermal management, trades well below the all-time closing high of $376.15 it set on May 14, according to Macrotrends.

So the money has moved again, one layer further down the stack. Investors hunting the next round of AI winners are now buying the companies that make vacuum pumps, heat exchangers and ultra high purity gases, the deeply unglamorous inputs without which a chip fab is an empty building.

Why chip fabs cannot run without pumps and gases

A modern semiconductor fab is essentially a very expensive vacuum. Etching and deposition steps happen in chambers pumped down to near space conditions, and the exhaust from those chambers is toxic enough to require its own abatement equipment.

Feeding those chambers takes nitrogen, argon, helium and a long list of specialty gases delivered at purity levels measured in parts per billion.

None of that shows up in a Nvidia keynote. All of it shows up in the capital budget of every fab under construction.

The scale is set upstream. ASML said its order intake stayed very strong through the first half and that it is planning roughly 30% more low numerical aperture extreme ultraviolet capacity for 2027, according to a company statement.

Every one of those lithography tools lands inside a fab that needs pumps, abatement and gas lines wrapped around it.

The same logic runs through the data center itself. Cooling is the piece investors already understand, and my colleagues have covered how hyperscalers are racing to lock in chiller capacity years ahead of need.

What gets missed is that the fab side of the equation is a consumables business.

Pumps need service. Gases get consumed and reordered. Abatement systems require replacement parts on a schedule for as long as the plant is running.

每次淘金热都会产生两种财富。 有些人找到黄金，有些人向他们出售铲子。 历史铭记了第一批人，也悄悄地丰富了第二批人。

人工智能（AI）的建设几乎完全遵循了这个剧本。 错过了英伟达（NVDA）的投资者纷纷涌入华尔街所谓的镐和铲交易，购买那些为数据中心提供电力和冷却的公司，而不是那些在数据中心内嗡嗡作响的芯片的公司。

那笔交易奏效了。 然后市场变得拥挤，拥挤的交易惩罚着失望。 据 Macrotrends 称，数据中心热管理领域最大的纯企业 Vertiv Holdings (VRT) 的交易价格远低于 5 月 14 日创下的历史收盘高点 376.15 美元。

因此，资金再次转移到了堆栈的下一层。 寻找下一轮人工智能获胜者的投资者现在正在购买那些制造真空泵、热交换器和超高纯度气体的公司，如果没有这些投入，芯片工厂就是一座空楼。

为什么芯片工厂没有泵和气体就无法运行

现代半导体工厂本质上是一个非常昂贵的真空。 蚀刻和沉积步骤发生在抽真空到接近太空条件的腔室中，这些腔室中排出的废气具有足够的毒性，需要自己的减排设备。

这些室需要氮气、氩气、氦气和一长串纯度为十亿分之一的特种气体。

这些都没有出现在 Nvidia 的主题演讲中。 所有这些都体现在每个在建晶圆厂的资本预算中。

更多人工智能股票：

  • 美国银行向英伟达股票投资者发出直言不讳的信息
  • 高盛刚刚回答了有关阿尔的最大问题
  • ASML 最近的下跌为人工智能投资者提供了难得的机会

秤设置在上游。 根据公司声明，ASML 表示，其上半年订单量保持强劲，并计划到 2027 年将低数值孔径极紫外线产能增加约 30%。

每一台光刻工具都安装在晶圆厂内，周围需要泵、废气处理和气体管线。

同样的逻辑贯穿数据中心本身。 冷却是投资者已经了解的部分，我的同事们已经介绍了超大型企业如何竞相提前数年锁定冷却器容量。

人们忽视的是，晶圆厂的另一面是消耗品业务。

泵需要维修。 气体被消耗并重新排序。 只要工厂运行，减排系统就需要按计划更换零件。
